content: “Makaalongo bhangu na makaatate bhangu, munyihwe hinu panyobhela kwa kulikingikiha!”
Paayihwite pakalongela nabho kwa nongelo ya Kibulania, bhakitama nuu kyanalumu. Naywo Paulo kakighendelela kulongela.

“Nenga Nnyahudi nbhelekwa ghwa Taliso nnima ghwa ku Kilikia. Peni ngulila mu nnima aghu ghwa ku Yelusalemu, nikibha nhundwa ghwa Gamalieli. Nikihundwa telatela kya kughatughila na kukamula malaghilo gha aghohi bhetu. Nikilibhuha kwa mwoyo ghumu kwa kya Chapanga handa mwenga pa mmeghite habhu lelo.
Nikiapegha nikiabamanda bhandu mbaka kuakoma bhoha bhaatughilite njila ayi. Nikibhakamula alume kwa adala na kuabhopa mu hibhopo.

Ndundame nkulu kangughumanya nnando aghu na aghohi bha libalasa ndo mayimiho bhangu, kiyaha bhakingamuha lihamba kuhuma kwa bhene lya kughenda kwa Akaayahudi bha ku Dameski, na nenga nikighenda akwo ngati nikaagheghe bhandu abho mbaka ku Yelusalemu handa mmopwa ngati ahyatulwe.”
Paulo kangulubhulila ya kya kulopoka kwake
“Pameghiti mu njila kughenda ku Dameski, na yikibhegha handa saa sita pamuhi, kamu lung'ali lukulu kuhuma kunane kwa Chapanga lukining'aliha mu mbande hyoha.
Nikighwegha pahi, na nukiyihwa lilobhe pa likinng'ombela, ‘Shauli, Shauli, kiyaha niki ghungumbamanda?’
Nenga nikiyanga, ‘Ghwenga ndo ghani Bambo’ Naywo kakinlongela, ‘Nenga ndo Yesu ghuyunyaghabhiha’
Bhandu bhaabheghiti papamu na nenga bhakilubhona lula lung'ali, peni bhakimanya ng'obhe lilobhe lya yula mundu ywakalongilite na nenga.
Ndo nikikonya, ‘Ndende niki Bambo.’ Naywo Bambo kakinng'ombela, ‘Ghuyinuke ghughende ku Dameski, akwo ghwaaghombelwa mihalo yiikunogheliti kuyitenda.’
Kiyaha nikihotola ng'obhe kulola yakya lula lung'ali, ayangu bhakingamua kibhoko na kunnongoha mbaka Kudamesiki.”
“Mundu yumu nnyitikila ghwa Chapanga na ywaakamuhite muno malaghilo ghetu, lihina lyake Anania, kakihika kunmona, na ywombe kakihokamilwa muno na Akaayahudi bhaatamite akwo ku Dameski.
Kakihika kwa nenga na kakiyima ugheghela kakilongela, ‘Nnongo Shauli, ghuhotole kubhona kangi!’ Lisaa lila lila nikihotola kubhona kangi, na nikihotola kummona.
Anania kakilongela, ‘Chapanga ghwa hukulu bhetu kaghuhaghula ghwenga ngati ghughumanye upalo ghwake, ghummone mwene ywakabheghite na shaliya na ghumokole kuyuhwa malagho kuhuma mu ngulu yake.
Kiyaha ghwabhegha nlongela ghwake kwa bhandu bhoha kwa kya kila ghukibhonite na kukiyihwa.
Hinu naha kiyaha niki kukabhalila? Ghuyinuke, ghukabatiswe na ulemwa ghwakwo ghwa ghululighwa, paghulikema lihina lyake.’ ”
Paulo kangukemwa kualandamiha bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Akaayahudi
“Mbole ya kubhuya ku Yelusalemu, pameghite mu kuyupa mu Kitutubhi kya Chapanga, kamu Chapanga kakimmoneha kilibhi,
nikimmona Yesu pakinng'ombela, ‘Ghuyumbatike ghubhuke ku Yelusalemu, kiyaha bhandu bha apa baaghuyitikila ng'obhe kughayihwa ghala gha ghughabhonite kwa kya nenga.’
Na nenga nikinnyanga, ‘Bambo, bhene bhangumanya kya bhula pang'endite mu hitutubhi nhanganganiko hya kutundamila Akaayahudi ngati kuabhika mu kibhopo na kuatuta bhala bhaakuhyubhalilite.
Pakakwomitwe nndumindumi ghwakwo Stefano na nenga nikiyima pa mbwegha, panyitikila ndendelo ayo na kughabhika maha maghwanda gha bhala bhaankomiteghe.’
Ndo Bambo kakinng'ombela, ‘Ghughende kiyaha ndakulaghila kutali, kwa bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Akaayahudi.’ ”
Lula lumati lwa bhandu lukinnyihwa Paulo mbaka pakalongilite lilagho alyo, ndo bhakiyobha kyobho paakilongela, “Mummuhe mu nnima kiyaha yingunnogha ng'obhe kulama.”
Paabheghite mu kuyobha kyobho paakighapumunda maghwanda ghabhe na kutikula malihu kunane,

Yula machonda kilongohi kakikwilikiha Paulo kayingihwe mu kitutubhi kikulu kya amachonda. Kakilaghila kakatutwe hinjupunjupu na kukonywa ngati amanye kiyaha niki bhandu akibhegha mu kuyobha kyobho kya abho.

Peni paamopite kala kwa ngoyi ya liyula ngati bhantute hinjupunjupu, Paulo kakinng'ombela nnyimilila machonda ywakayimite pala ugheghela na mwene, “Bhuli yibha tela kwa mwenga kuntuta nkolannima ghwa ku Loma kya nga kutoswa na malaghilo?”
Yula machonda pakayihwite agho malagho, kakinng'endela yula kilongohi ghwa Machonda na kunng'ombela, “Ghungupala kutenda niki? Kiyaha mundu aywo ndo nkolannima ghwa ku Loma.”
Yula kilongohi nkulu ghwa machonda kakighenda kunkonya Paulo, “Ghung'ombele ghwenga ghu nkolannima ghwa Loma?” Paulo kakiyanga, “Ena.”
Ndo yula kilongohi ghwa machonda kakilongela, “Nenga yikimmuka ngalabha ngulu kubha nkolannima ghwa Loma.” Paulo kakilongela, “Peni nenga nkolannima ghwa ku Loma ghwa kubhelekwa.”

Kamu bhala bhaapalite kunkonya bhakibhuka kya kuyumbatika na yula kilongohi ghwa machonda kakiyingila kwa kuyoghopa, pakamanyite kukita Paulo kakibha nkolannima ghwa ku Loma kangi kakimmopa kwa minyololo.
Paulo kangulipingikiha mu ulongolo ghwa libalasa

Kilabho yake, kiyaha yula kilongohi ghwa machonda kakipala kumanya yibha bhuli kangukokelwa na Akaayahudi, kakimmopola na kakilaghila hilongohi bha Andundame na libalasa lyoha likongane. Mbole kaking'egha Paulo na kakinnyimiha mu ulongolo ghwabhe.
